servers.name: smartsheet
servers.description: PMO tool. Sheets, rows, project data.

_notes: Add an integration = add an entry here. No code changes.
Public web search and page reads use Tavily, not a browser server.
Repeated unmet requests appear on /admin/unmet as disabled connector candidates. Paste one here only after its API URL and allowlist are known. Leave enabled false until then.
authEnv names the env var holding the bearer token.
allowTools is an allowlist — omit it to expose every tool the server offers.
Keep allowlists tight on write-capable servers; the agent can call anything listed.
confirmTools: write-capable tools parked for human approval before execution.
urlEnv: if set, the live URL is process.env[urlEnv] (Bicep writes it). Native web_search is separate.
